units.source_text: 心脏像破了的乒乓球，不规则地弹跳着。

en.t: His heart bounced irregularly like a cracked ping-pong ball.

units.source_text: 偏偏要去联想，他不明白自己怎么净想些不吉利的事情呀。

en.t: Of all things, his mind had to make that association; he could not understand why he kept thinking such unlucky thoughts.

units.source_text: 即使不那么想象，十月的凉风里充满了近乎苦闷的悔恨之声。

en.t: Even without imagining it that way, the cool October wind was filled with voices of regret that were almost anguish.

units.source_text: 豆子崩破了豆荚，空空的豆荚，如笛子吹响般飞去了。

en.t: The beans burst through the pods, and the empty pods flew away as if a flute had sounded.

units.source_text: 他抬起头，仰望着淡淡月光勾勒出来的洞穴边缘，

en.t: He raised his head and looked up at the rim of the pit outlined by the faint moonlight,

units.source_text: 他觉得，这种灼热的感情也许是出乎意料的嫉妒吧。

en.t: and he felt that this burning emotion might perhaps be an unexpected jealousy.

units.source_text: 也许是对所有事物的嫉妒吧：

en.t: Perhaps it was jealousy toward everything:

units.source_text: 街道、上下班列车、十字路口的信号灯、电线杆上的广告、

en.t: the streets, commuter trains, traffic lights at intersections, advertisements on telephone poles,

units.source_text: 猫的尸体、卖香烟的药房，这些地面上表示密度的一切。

en.t: a cat's corpse, a pharmacy that sold cigarettes, everything on the surface that indicated density.

units.source_text: 就像沙子吞噬着板壁和柱子内部一样，

en.t: Just as the sand was devouring the insides of the board walls and posts,

units.source_text: 嫉妒在他的内部挖了一个洞，也许正使他变成炉子上架着的空锅。

en.t: jealousy had dug a hole inside him and perhaps was turning him into an empty pot set on a stove.
The temperature of the empty pot rose suddenly.

units.source_text: 不久，他受不住这份热，难保不会自己将自己抛出去。

en.t: Before long, unable to bear the heat, he might well fling himself out.

units.source_text: 谈论希望之前，首要的问题是能不能跨越这个瞬间。

en.t: Before speaking of hope, the first question was whether he could get through this moment.
